members.name: scopedElements
members.default: { "dna-canvas-alert": DnaCanvasAlert, "dna-canvas-info-button": DnaCanvasInfoButton, "dna-phase-complete-toast": DnaPhaseCompleteToast, "dna-simulation-navbar": DnaSimulationNavbar, "dna-codon-card": DnaCodonCard, "sl-icon": SlIcon, "sl-button": SlButton, "sl-dialog": SlDialog, "sl-popup": SlPopup, }

members.name: sequenceTabWarnings
members.description: Sequence-tab hints for authors only — never shown in student view.

members.name: mutationsSequence
members.description: Sequence the Mutations tab displays and edits.

members.name: _helicaseAwaitingSplitSettle
members.description: Waiting for the fork base-pair split transition before playing exit.

members.name: _codonDrawerClosing
members.description:
True while the drawer is playing its slide-out/fade-out exit — kept
expanded (and its content mounted) until the animation finishes.

members.name: _workspace
members.default: new WorkspaceController(this, { getZoomLevel: () => this.zoomLevel, setZoomLevel: (z) => { this.zoomLevel = z }, getPanEnabled: () => this.allowStudentPan || this.editable, onViewportClick: (e) => this._onMutationsViewportClick(e), onUserPanZoom: () => this._mutations.dismiss(), })

members.name: _mutationsWorkingCopy
members.description: Isolated Mutations-tab copy when cross-phase mutations are off.

members.name: _baukastenOrder
members.description: Toolkit chip order — shuffled once when the widget instance is created.

members.name: _syncCanvasRowHeight
members.description:
Pin canvas under the navbar: set --dna-navbar-height from the real
navbar box (tabs + child nav + optional extra bar).
Canvas uses top/bottom absolute pinning, so it cannot outgrow `.sim-shell`.

members.name: _maybeScheduleHelicaseExit
members.description:
After the last base pair splits, wait for its transform transition, then
play the helicase exit and show the replication-complete toast.

members.name: _forkSplitTransitionTarget
members.description: Top subunit of the fork pair that just finished splitting.

members.name: defaultZoomForPhase
members.description: Public so ResetController can pick the phase default zoom.

members.name: focusMrnaInput
members.description: TranscriptionHost: wait for render, then ask the navbar to focus its mRNA field.

members.name: _invalidateTranscriptionAndTranslationCompletion
members.description: Cross-phase DNA edits must not keep Transcription/Translation marked as complete.

members.name: _onMutationsViewportClick
members.description: Clear Mutations selection/menu when clicking empty canvas (base clicks stopPropagation).

members.name: _mutationMenuAnchor
members.description: DOM node for the selected base — used as the sl-popup anchor.

members.name: substituteBase
members.description:
Replace the DNA template base at `index` (Mutations phase).
No-ops if the index/base is invalid or unchanged.

members.name: insertBase
members.description:
Insert a DNA template base before `index` (0 … length inclusive).
No-ops if the index/base is invalid.

members.name: deleteBase
members.description:
Delete the DNA template base at `index`.
No-ops if the index is out of range.

members.name: _applyMutationSequenceEdit
members.description: Mutation edits: shared `dnaSequence` or an isolated session copy.

members.name: _applyDnaSequenceEdit
members.description: Shared path for lesson-DNA edits: clamp anim and drop stale tx/tl completion.

members.name: DRAWER_TRANSITION_MS
members.description: Matches the .codon-drawer transition in dna-simulation.styles.ts.

members.name: _openCodonDrawerForRibosome
members.description: Open the codon drawer after snapping the ribosome, forcing a recenter even if it was already open.

members.name: _centerOnActiveCodon
members.description: Keep the ribosome's current codon in the middle of the visible canvas.
